name: Generative AI & LLMs
description: How large language models work and how to build with them: prompting, RAG, agents, fine-tuning and safe deployment.

nodes.name: How LLMs work
nodes.desc: Next-token prediction with decoder-only transformers, and what models can and cannot do.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain how decoder-only transformers generate text by next-token prediction and what LLMs can and cannot do.

nodes.name: Tokens & context
nodes.desc: Tokenisers, context windows and how token counts drive cost and limits.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain how tokenisers split text, how context windows limit inputs and how token counts drive cost.

nodes.name: Sampling & decoding
nodes.desc: Greedy decoding, temperature, top-k and top-p sampling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to control generation with greedy decoding, temperature, top-k and top-p sampling.

nodes.name: Pretraining at scale
nodes.desc: Training data, scaling laws and the compute behind foundation models.
nodes.summary: You will be able to describe how foundation models are pretrained, including training data, scaling laws and compute requirements.

nodes.name: Prompt engineering
nodes.desc: Clear instructions, examples, roles and step-by-step reasoning prompts.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write effective prompts using clear instructions, examples, roles and step-by-step reasoning.

nodes.name: LLM APIs
nodes.desc: Calling models over an API: messages, parameters, streaming and error handling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to call LLMs over an API with messages and parameters, stream responses and handle errors and rate limits.

nodes.name: Structured output
nodes.desc: Getting reliable JSON and schema-conforming output from a model.
nodes.summary: You will be able to get reliable JSON and schema-conforming output from a model and validate it.

nodes.name: Chat assistant
nodes.desc: Build a chat assistant with conversation memory and a structured action output.
nodes.summary: You will build a chat assistant that keeps conversation memory and produces structured action outputs.

nodes.name: Text embeddings
nodes.desc: Embedding models for similarity, clustering and retrieval.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use embedding models to measure semantic similarity and to cluster and retrieve text.

nodes.name: Vector databases
nodes.desc: Storing embeddings and querying them with approximate nearest-neighbour indexes.
nodes.summary: You will be able to store embeddings in a vector database and query them with approximate nearest-neighbour indexes.

nodes.name: RAG
nodes.desc: Retrieval-augmented generation: chunking, retrieval, re-ranking and grounded answers.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with chunking, retrieval, re-ranking and grounded answers.

nodes.name: Tools & agents
nodes.desc: Tool calling, agent loops, planning and giving models access to external systems.
nodes.summary: You will be able to give models access to external systems with tool calling and build agent loops that plan and act.

nodes.name: RAG app
nodes.desc: Build a question-answering app over your own documents with citations.
nodes.summary: You will build a question-answering app over your own documents that cites its sources.

nodes.name: Fine-tuning
nodes.desc: Supervised fine-tuning on instruction data and when it beats prompting.
nodes.summary: You will be able to fine-tune an LLM on instruction data and decide when fine-tuning beats prompting.

nodes.name: LoRA & PEFT
nodes.desc: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with adapters, LoRA and quantised training.
nodes.summary: You will be able to fine-tune large models efficiently with adapters, LoRA and quantised training such as QLoRA.

nodes.name: Alignment
nodes.desc: Preference tuning with RLHF and DPO and the goals of alignment.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain the goals of alignment and how preference tuning with RLHF and DPO shapes model behaviour.

nodes.name: Multimodal models
nodes.desc: Models that read and generate images, audio and text together.
nodes.summary: You will be able to describe how multimodal models read and generate images, audio and text together.

nodes.name: Evaluating LLMs
nodes.desc: Benchmarks, task-specific evals, LLM-as-judge and regression testing prompts.
nodes.summary: You will be able to evaluate LLM systems with benchmarks, task-specific evals, LLM-as-judge and prompt regression tests.

nodes.name: Inference & serving
nodes.desc: Quantisation, KV caching, batching, latency and cost control.
nodes.summary: You will be able to serve LLMs efficiently using quantisation, KV caching and batching while controlling latency and cost.

nodes.name: Safety & security
nodes.desc: Prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage and guardrails.
nodes.summary: You will be able to defend LLM applications against prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leakage with guardrails.

nodes.name: Agent capstone
nodes.desc: Ship a tool-using agent with evaluations and safety checks.
nodes.summary: You will ship a tool-using agent with an evaluation suite and safety checks.
